newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank raises overnight rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank raises overnight rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday it had raised its overnight borrowing rate to 11.5 percent from 10.25 percent.
The bank said it also increased its overnight lending rate to 13.5 percent from 12.75 percent.
Traders said they were surprised by the significant increase in the Central Bank's overnight rates.
"I think the Central Bank's move was to prevent further speculation in the foreign exchange market," said one local trader.
The Philippine peso ended sharply down at 26.265 on Monday from 26.211 following a fall in the overnight money and treasury bill rates.
The Central Bank had bought more than $100 million out of total transactions of $283.7 million to support the peso on Monday. -- Manila newsroom (632) 841-89-36, fax 817-62-67
